task_intro: This dataset predicts whether a credit applicant should be considered good or bad credit risk based on financial history, loan purpose, savings, employment, and personal status information.

num.installment_commitment: installment rate as percentage of disposable income
num.existing_credits: number of existing credits at this bank
num.num_dependents: number of people financially dependent on the applicant

cat.own_telephone: whether the applicant owns a telephone
cat.foreign_worker: whether the applicant is a foreign worker

target_intro.good: credit risk is low and the applicant is likely to repay
target_intro.bad: credit risk is high and the applicant is more likely to default
